disabled.description: Grays the row out and stops pointer events inside its CellComponents, so controls in the row cannot be used. Tags and icons in the row are dimmed to match.

hover.description: Gives the row a hover background, and is also required for its tooltip to appear. TableHeader sets it to false for the header row.

rowHeight.description: Caps the row's height, in pixels.

selected.description: Gives the row's cells the accent surface used for selection. It is styling only; it sets no ARIA state.

shouldShowTooltipOnHover.description: Wraps the row in a Tooltip, but only while hover is also true. On its own it shows nothing: a row tooltip needs tooltipText as well.

tooltipProps.description: Passed to the Tooltip, and overrides the defaults the row sets (arrow, dark style).

tooltipSubtitle.description: A second line below the tooltip's title.

useDivider.description: Draws the 1px divider along the bottom of the row.
